say:1:1322046001:1.text: Rivanna and Alex told me what happened tonight. Apologies for being late.
say:1:1322046001:1.source_cn: 里芙娜和亚历克斯已经跟我说了今晚的事情，很抱歉，看起来...

say:5:1322046003:1.text: Fighting with her was fun but painful.
say:5:1322046003:1.source_cn: 和她打架很有趣，但是疼！

say:8:1322046004:0.text: That Graveborn and her son—do they really mean no harm to the people of Cedartown?
say:8:1322046004:0.source_cn: 那位女亡灵，还有她的儿子，他们真的对雪松镇的人没有敌意吗？

say:9:1322046005:1.text: It seems that Daimon just wants to play with the children, and Shemira is particularly concerned about the safety of her son...
say:9:1322046005:1.source_cn: 看起来戴蒙只是想和孩子们一起玩耍，而雪米拉特别在意戴蒙...

say:10:1322046006:1.text: She carries herself with such strength and grace, yet the mere mention of Daimon unravels her. She grows anxious, overreacts, and becomes utterly irrational...
say:10:1322046006:1.source_cn: 雪米拉明明看起来是位坚韧优雅的女士，但每次一提到戴蒙，...

say:12:1322046007:1.text: But she's really strong. She even wounded Igor. If she thinks that people are tricking Daimon, something serious may happen...
say:12:1322046007:1.source_cn: 而且她的力量很强，连伊戈尔都被她打伤了。如果下次她再误...

say:13:1322046008:1.text: Do we have to resort to force? Our manpower is limited at the moment...
say:13:1322046008:1.source_cn: 难道必须要用武力解决这件事？可卫队人力实在有限……

say:15:1322046009:1.text: After so many years, the people of Whiteridge have finally begun to change their views on the Graveborn. The last thing I want is to stir up trouble and undo all that progress.
say:15:1322046009:1.source_cn: 白山公国的人们刚刚才对亡灵有所改观，好不容易解开了多年...

choice_prompt:16:1322046009.text: After so many years, the people of Whiteridge have finally begun to change their views on the Graveborn. The last thing I want is to stir up trouble and undo all that progress.
choice_prompt:16:1322046009.source_cn: 白山公国的人们刚刚才对亡灵有所改观，好不容易解开了多年的误解，我……我也不想再和他们起冲突。

say:18:1322046012:1.text: Ah, yes! We can ask General Valka for help.
say:18:1322046012:1.source_cn: ……我想到了，魔法师大人，或许可以找瓦丽卡将军帮忙。

say:19:1322046013:1.text: She holds sway among the Graveborn in Whiteridge. Perhaps she can explain the situation to Lady Shemira.
say:19:1322046013:1.source_cn: 瓦丽卡将军在白山公国的亡灵中颇有人望，也许由她出面，能...

say:20:1322046014:1.text: Since she's also a Graveborn, maybe she can get Lady Shemira to lower her guard and actually listen to what we have to say.
say:20:1322046014:1.source_cn: 同为女性亡灵，也许能让雪米拉女士卸下心防，听听我们的建议。

say:21:1322046015:0.text: This is a solid plan. If Valka and Shemira can talk things out, we might be able to resolve this without any bloodshed.
say:21:1322046015:0.source_cn: 这个主意不错！请瓦丽卡和雪米拉女士好好沟通一下，也许就...

say:24:1322046016:1.text: Oh, right! Since there's a powerful Graveborn in town, we have to let Valka know.
say:24:1322046016:1.source_cn: 喔，对！有很厉害的亡灵来玩，要让瓦丽卡知道！

say:25:1322046017:1.text: Valka can beat her! This is gonna get interesting!
say:25:1322046017:1.source_cn: 瓦丽卡能赢她！旧的和新的碰头，有意思！

say:26:1322046018:1.text: I'll take you to find Valka!

say:29:1322046019:1.text: The Graveborn are fighting in Cedartown... When this news spreads, it will cause anxiety among the townsfolk. I'll need to stay here and help keep everyone calm.
say:29:1322046019:1.source_cn: 亡灵们在雪松镇里战斗……这件事传出去一定会让镇上的人焦...

say:30:1322046020:1.text: Magister, I'm counting on you to find General Valka.
say:30:1322046020:1.source_cn: 魔法师大人，瓦丽卡将军那边就拜托你了。
say:30:1322046020:1.male: Magister, I'm counting on you to find General Valka.
say:30:1322046020:1.female: Magister, I'm counting on you to find General Valka.

say:31:1322046021:0.text: Don't worry, Captain Rodrigo. Focus on comforting the children and parents in town. We'll have Igor help us <style="highlight">track down Valka</style>.
say:31:1322046021:0.source_cn: 嗯，那就拜托罗德里戈先生好好安慰镇中的孩子和他们的家长...

say:33:1322046011:1.text: Who can help us resolve the issue with the Graveborn?
say:33:1322046011:1.source_cn: 还有谁能够帮助我们解决亡灵的问题？
